patterns.message: Import the service instance from ~/services. Only the composition root (src/services.ts) and tests import service modules.

patterns.message: Services hold I/O and domain logic. They import no React, router, TanStack, Zustand, UI, routes, or service instances; dependencies arrive through Deps.

paths.react-router: lib/ui is the design system and stays router-agnostic. Aria links navigate through the RouterProvider in lib/app.
paths.zustand: lib/ui is the design system; app state belongs to routes or a named src/lib capability.

patterns.message: lib/ui is the design system. Bind TanStack to UI in the owning route or a named capability such as lib/form.
lib/ui imports only itself. App wiring lives in lib/app; other capabilities compose lib/ui, not the reverse.
